items.item_text: DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Performs departmental operations, including processing a variety of documents, updating student records, and registering students. 2. Perform computer data entry and/or retrieval of all academic records, including admissions applications, enrollments, drop/adds, withdrawals, and other related personal student information. 3. Assist the Director in the verification of student residency requirements. 4. Scan and link documents in imaging system. 5. Answers questions regarding registration, admissions, and student records policies and procedures of the District. 6. Assist with preparation and distribution of grades, and student schedules. 7. Prepares, copies, collates, and distributes a variety of documents; ensures proper filing of copies in departmental or central files. 8. Assists students with registration process, including online accounts and applications and late adds and reinstatements. 9. Assist with data entry of MIS data to comply with state reporting requirements. 10. Assist the Director with probation/dismissal processes. 11. Assist the Director with graduation processes. 12. Respond to telephone inquiries regarding records. 13. Assist in processing transcript requests, certification of attendance requests, and directory requests. 14. Monitor supply stock; reorder and/or copy admissions applications and various admission forms as needed. 15. Perform general typing and filing. 16. Learns and applies emerging technologies and, as necessary, to perform duties in an efficient, organized, and timely manner 17. Perform other work-related duties, as assigned.
